title: Rosa roxburghii Tratt fruit extract ameliorate free fatty acid induced steatosis in HepG2 cells through activating PI3K-Akt and PPAR pathways.
authors: Ling, Yihan; Wang, Wenxi; Li, Xingjie; Wang, Xiaomeng; Zhang, Shuwen; Huang, Shaolin; Zhou, Heting; Peng, Lijun; Yin, Wenya
one_liner_zh: 该文研究刺梨提取物改善肝细胞脂肪变性，涉及PI3K-Akt和PPAR通路，但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，且方法仅分子对接且非针对TF-DNA，与本课题无关。
abstract: There has been a continuous increase in the global incidence of obesity. Rosa roxburghii Tratt (RRT), a plant with medicinal and edible uses, contains active components that can alleviate obesity, indicating an anti-obesity potential. This research sought to investigate the anti-obesity effects of RRT fruit extract (RRTE) and elucidate the underlying mechanisms and components responsible for its action. RRTE was obtained by enriching the active ingredient in RRT and used to treat HepG2 cells. RRTE alleviated cellular lipid accumulation, reduced reactive oxygen species production, restored cellular mitochondrial function, and enhanced energy metabolism. Network pharmacology combined with molecular docking was used to determine the targets, components, and mechanisms, which were validated through in vitro experiments. p-Coumaric acid and ethyl caffeate were identified as lipid-lowering active components that may reduce lipid accumulation and alleviate obesity through the PI3K-Akt and PPAR signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 全球肥胖发病率持续上升。刺梨（Rosa roxburghii Tratt, RRT）作为一种药食两用植物，其活性成分可缓解肥胖，显示出抗肥胖潜力。本研究旨在探讨刺梨果实提取物（RRTE）的抗肥胖作用，并阐明其作用机制及有效成分。通过富集刺梨中的活性成分获得RRTE，并用于处理HepG2细胞。RRTE缓解了细胞脂质积累，减少了活性氧产生，恢复了细胞线粒体功能，并增强了能量代谢。结合网络药理学与分子对接技术，确定了靶点、成分及机制，并通过体外实验进行了验证。对香豆酸和咖啡酸乙酯被鉴定为降脂活性成分，可能通过PI3K-Akt和PPAR信号通路减少脂质积累并缓解肥胖。
